entries.speaker: Sture Allén
entries.quote: Your rich and complex work invites us to reconsider the fundamental things in life.
entries.work: Presentation speech for the Nobel Prize in Literature 1988, awarded to Naguib Mahfouz, on behalf of the Swedish Academy
entries.context: The speech quotes Mahfouz on time — “Time cuts like a sword. If you don’t kill it, it kills you.” — and speaks of love as a source of strength in an inexplicable world.
